name: Slite
label: Slite API v1
description: Slite API v1 via OfficialApiNode (nodes/slite/api_spec.json). Official Slite API v1. Header x-slite-api-key. Published rate limit 120 calls/minute. Often plan-gated. Official docs: https://developers.slite.com/. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Slite official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"doc_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'doc_create', 'doc_get', 'doc_update', 'doc_delete', 'doc_search', 'note_list', 'channel_list', 'account_me'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'doc_create'.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `title` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: markdown
schema.description: Slite note body (markdown). On create/update this is the official wire field. Alias: INPUT `content` is promoted to `markdown` when `markdown` is blank. Example: '# Hello'.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Agent-friendly alias for note body on doc_create/doc_update (mapped to `markdown` before HTTP). On doc_get, Slite returns body text in response field `content`.

schema.label: html
schema.description: Optional HTML body on create/update (official alternative to markdown).

schema.label: format
schema.description: doc_get query: content format md | html | sliteml (Slite `format` query param).

schema.label: parentNoteId
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `parentNoteId` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: templateId
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `templateId` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: noteId
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `noteId` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `query` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: doc_create, doc_get, doc_update, doc_delete, doc_search, note_list, channel_list, account_me. Default: doc_create. Example: doc_create.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=header (configKey api_key). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
